$comment: Repo registry (policy, no secrets): which repos the factory manages and what it is allowed to do in each. Runtime config stays in factory/config/<owner>_<repo>.json; the per-deployment supervision file with webhook secrets lives in fleet/. Three decisions are policy because their failure mode is not a crash: whether a repo may be auto-merged, which label makes an issue eligible for pickup, and which paths a run may change (pathAllowlist; vendor/ is protected everywhere regardless). See research/multi-repo-factory-plan.md §5.11.

repos.note: N3 dogfood target, enabled for LOCAL human-dispatched self-work only: there is no fleet entry and no published webhook listener, so nothing starts a factory here by itself; runs are started deliberately (gates/self-run-task.mjs) against this checkout. autoMerge is false permanently — drydock runs stop at the draft PR for a human to merge (§5.11). pathAllowlist deliberately excludes gates/ so a self-run cannot edit the oracles that judge it, and gates/probes/ is additionally protected.
